units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1920x1080 frame) and seconds; no metric scale guessed
summary: Static (tripod-like, tiny drift) side view of a sunny tennis-court path. One person (white long-sleeve top, light cap, khaki cargo trousers, face blurred/greyed by anonymisation) rides a black two-wheel electric kick scooter from left to right along the asphalt path in front of the green-screened court fence. Rider stands on the deck the whole clip (no kicking seen). Starts fully visible at x~385-590 (frame 0), leaves the right image edge at the end (front wheel clipped at frame 74, gone from 75; body cut by the edge from ~75; rear wheel still visible at frame 80).

camera.motion: static; small slow drift measured by phase correlation of the ground strip y=760..1080 vs frame 0: dx from 0 to +2.1 px (max near frame 55-60, back to -0.35 at 80), dy from 0 to -3.6 px (frame 80). Per-frame values: cam_dx/cam_dy columns in tracks/rider_scooter.csv. Negligible against the rider's ~15-20 px/frame motion; not subtracted in the track columns.

perspective.note: Labelled 2D, but the rider's path is slightly oblique: the scooter's apparent size shrinks and its wheels rise in the image as it moves right, i.e. it moves slightly away from the camera.

scooter_outer_length_px.how: hand-read rear-of-rear-wheel to front-of-front-wheel at frames 0/40/72; per-frame estimate = 1.267 x wheelbase in the track

perspective.ground_plane: asphalt path y~700-760 (fence-base edge ~y 700), light concrete sidewalk y~760-850 with an expansion joint near x~840, wood-chip mulch y>850 in the foreground; all edges nearly horizontal.
